name: thought-bubble
description: A soft thought cloud with two separate trailing bubbles.
useCase: Represent an unspoken thought or open brainstorming notes.
misuse: Use a label to state the specific communication or time-related action.

16.reason: A full thought cloud and two detached circles form a clear diminishing thought trail.

24.reason: The broad cloud and two separate trailing bubbles keep the thought symbol readable beside text.
